verdict.rationale: Khoj's core feature is chat grounded in your own files, notes, and Notion and GitHub sources. It can also generate and run Python to analyze data and produce plots and reports, and scheduled automations email research results back to you. Obsidian's "find similar notes" adds a light suggestion layer. missing for 10: evidence of proactive, unprompted insights or suggestions beyond user-scheduled queries, and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality (the only hands-on report on retrieval, a test with Slovene notes, found it poor for non-English content).
